name: node-red

check.cmd: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash node-red > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall

install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && export NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node && hash node > /dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install --lts
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash npm > /dev/null 2>&1 && npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash node-red > /dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g --unsafe-perm node-red

export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd ~/.node-red && npm i node-red-node-rdk-camera node-red-node-rdk-vision node-red-contrib-image-tools node-red-node-rdk-gpio node-red-node-alibaba-llms node-red-node-rdk-tools
install-en: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && export NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node && hash node > /dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install --lts
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash npm > /dev/null 2>&1 && npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && hash node-red > /dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g --unsafe-perm node-red

export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd ~/.node-red && npm i node-red-node-rdk-camera node-red-node-rdk-vision node-red-contrib-image-tools node-red-node-rdk-gpio node-red-node-alibaba-llms node-red-node-rdk-tools
uninstall: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && npm uninstall -g node-red && bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://gitee.com/RubyMetric/nvm-cn/raw/main/uninstall.sh)" && [ -d ~/.node-red ] && sudo rm -rf ~/.node-red

description.en: Node-RED is a flow-based, low-code development tool for visual programming.
